Updated the existing `treasury-bulletin-trust-fund-flows` skill with the generalizable pattern:

- Aggregate monthly “total U.S. federal trust account receipts” uses the all-trust-account `Total receipts` row for the named calendar months.
- Keep values in millions of USD.
- For `USD-CAD`, treat the rate as CAD per USD and multiply the USD-million difference by the specified monthly average rate.
- If one exchange-rate month is specified, apply that one rate to the whole difference.

Also updated memory compactly with the USD-CAD trust-fund conversion pitfall.
